## Summary
- Track when a tool name is extracted from a raw JSON-envelope argument buffer.
- For no-converter parser-engine configs, stream only the arguments or parameters value instead of leaking envelope syntax after the name field.
- Add streaming/non-streaming parity regressions for Hermes-style JSON envelopes across single-delta and char-by-char streams.

Fixes #47977

## Duplicate checks
- Checked issue #47977 comments: no PR linked.
- Checked open PRs mentioning #47977: none.
- Checked open PRs matching JSON-envelope parser-engine arg-converter terms: none.

## Tests
- .venv/bin/python -m pytest --confcutdir=tests/parser/engine tests/parser/engine/test_parser_engine.py -q
- .venv/bin/python -m pytest --confcutdir=tests/parser/engine tests/parser/engine/test_engine.py tests/parser/engine/test_parser_engine.py -q
- .venv/bin/pre-commit run --files vllm/parser/engine/parser_engine.py tests/parser/engine/test_parser_engine.py

## Disclosure
This PR was prepared with OpenAI Codex assistance.

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

Reviewed and independently verified this beyond the PR's own tests.

The `_json_envelope_arg_value_prefix` scanner is a solid approach, correctly locates the `arguments`/`parameters` value regardless of key order, handles nested containers, escaped quotes, and unicode. I tested several additional cases on top of the PR's own tests:

- Unicode content in argument values
- A nested key literally named `"arguments"` inside the real arguments object (checks the scanner finds the top-level key, not a nested one)
- Escaped quotes inside string values
- Two parallel tool calls
- `arguments` key not first, unusual whitespace, bare non-container values, arrays with commas inside strings

All matched non-streaming output exactly. LGTM, thorough fix.

+def _collect_streamed_tool_arguments(
+    engine: ParserEngine,
+    request: ChatCompletionRequest,
+    chunks: list[str],
+) -> str:
+    parts: list[str] = []
+    engine.initialize_streaming()
+    for chunk in chunks:
+        delta = engine.parse_delta(chunk, [], request, finished=False)
+        if delta is None:
+            continue
+        for tc in delta.tool_calls or []:
+            if tc.function and tc.function.arguments:
+                parts.append(tc.function.arguments)
+
+    delta = engine.parse_delta("", [], request, finished=True)
+    if delta is not None:
+        for tc in delta.tool_calls or []:
+            if tc.function and tc.function.arguments:
+                parts.append(tc.function.arguments)
+    return "".join(parts)
+

+    def _compute_raw_arg_delta(self, idx: int, raw_delta: str) -> str | None:

+    @classmethod
+    def _json_envelope_arg_value_prefix(cls, raw_args: str) -> str | None:
+        value_start = cls._find_json_envelope_arg_value_start(raw_args)
+        if value_start is None:
+            return None
+        return cls._json_value_prefix(raw_args, value_start)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _find_json_envelope_arg_value_start(cls, raw_args: str) -> int | None:
+        i = 0
+        end = len(raw_args)
+        while i < end and raw_args[i].isspace():
+            i += 1
+        if i >= end or raw_args[i] != "{":
+            return None
+        i += 1
+
+        while i < end:
+            while i < end and raw_args[i].isspace():
+                i += 1
+            if i < end and raw_args[i] == ",":
+                i += 1
+                continue
+            if i >= end or raw_args[i] != '"':
+                return None
+
+            key_end = cls._json_string_end(raw_args, i)
+            if key_end is None:
+                return None
+            try:
+                key = json.loads(raw_args[i:key_end])
+            except json.JSONDecodeError:
+                return None
+
+            i = key_end
+            while i < end and raw_args[i].isspace():
+                i += 1
+            if i >= end or raw_args[i] != ":":
+                return None
+            i += 1
+            while i < end and raw_args[i].isspace():
+                i += 1
+
+            if key in cls._ARG_VALUE_KEYS:
+                return i
+
+            value_end = cls._json_value_end(raw_args, i)
+            if value_end is None:
+                return None
+            i = value_end
+        return None
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _json_string_end(text: str, start: int) -> int | None:
+        if start >= len(text) or text[start] != '"':
+            return None
+        escaped = False
+        for i in range(start + 1, len(text)):
+            ch = text[i]
+            if escaped:
+                escaped = False
+            elif ch == "\\":
+                escaped = True
+            elif ch == '"':
+                return i + 1
+        return None
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _json_container_end(cls, text: str, start: int) -> int | None:
+        pairs = {"{": "}", "[": "]"}
+        if start >= len(text) or text[start] not in pairs:
+            return None
+
+        stack = [text[start]]
+        in_string = False
+        escaped = False
+        for i in range(start + 1, len(text)):
+            ch = text[i]
+            if in_string:
+                if escaped:
+                    escaped = False
+                elif ch == "\\":
+                    escaped = True
+                elif ch == '"':
+                    in_string = False
+                continue
+
+            if ch == '"':
+                in_string = True
+            elif ch in pairs:
+                stack.append(ch)
+            elif ch in pairs.values():
+                if not stack or pairs[stack[-1]] != ch:
+                    return None
+                stack.pop()
+                if not stack:
+                    return i + 1
+        return None
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _json_value_end(cls, text: str, start: int) -> int | None:
+        end = len(text)
+        while start < end and text[start].isspace():
+            start += 1
+        if start >= end:
+            return None
+
+        ch = text[start]
+        if ch == '"':
+            return cls._json_string_end(text, start)
+        if ch in "{[":
+            return cls._json_container_end(text, start)
+
+        i = start
+        while i < end and text[i] not in ",}]":
+            i += 1
+        if i == end:
+            return None
+        return i
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _json_value_prefix(cls, text: str, start: int) -> str | None:
+        end = len(text)
+        while start < end and text[start].isspace():
+            start += 1
+        if start >= end:
+            return None
+
+        ch = text[start]
+        if ch == '"':
+            value_end = cls._json_string_end(text, start)
+            if value_end is None:
+                return None
+            try:
+                value = json.loads(text[start:value_end])
+            except json.JSONDecodeError:
+                return None
+            return value if isinstance(value, str) else None
+
+        if ch in "{[":
+            value_end = cls._json_container_end(text, start)
+            if value_end is None:
+                return text[start:]
+            return text[start:value_end]
+
+        i = start
+        while i < end and text[i] not in ",}]":
+            i += 1
+        return text[start:i].rstrip()
